tools.name: list_offerings
tools.description: Everything on sale at zhannett.com: photo walks and art picnics (kind `experience`, booked for a date) and guides (kind `guide`, a PDF with an optional map subscription). Prices in euros.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: One offering in detail: description, duration, the group sizes with their prices (a total, or `price_per_guest_eur`) and what is paid at booking (a prepayment, or `paid_in_full_at_booking`), the booking and refund rules, and the page URL.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free start times of an experience, per group size, between two dates (at most 31 days at once, up to 90 days ahead; default: the next 14 days). Times are in the experience's time zone (Europe/Lisbon).

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Checks that a start time from check_availability is still free and returns `confirm_url`: the zhannett.com page where the customer signs in, sees the price and prepayment, and books by paying the prepayment. Nothing is booked or held until they do. Works without sign-in.

tools.name: prepare_guide_purchase
tools.description: Returns `buy_url`, the zhannett.com page where the customer buys a guide's PDF (and pays on Stripe's page), or, when signed in, says they already own it. Nothing is charged until they pay.

tools.name: prepare_map_subscription
tools.description: Returns `subscribe_url`, the zhannett.com page where the customer subscribes monthly to a guide's map (paying on Stripe's page), or, when signed in, says they already subscribe. Nothing is charged until they pay.

tools.name: list_my_bookings
tools.description: The signed-in customer's upcoming bookings (or all of them with include_past): date and local time, status, whether it is paid, whether cancelling now refunds the prepayment in full, and links to manage or reschedule it.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: One of the signed-in customer's bookings, with the same details as list_my_bookings.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking of the signed-in customer. Ask the customer to confirm first. tools.name: list_my_purchases
tools.description: The signed-in customer's guides (PDFs they bought) and map subscriptions, with their status, renewal or end date, and links.
